sam_sales: HaloTech POC blocked — rerank call returns 400 dims mismatch and sometimes 413 on big uploads. Need a quick swarm. :eyes:
leo_eng: Paste the raw error + a sanitized payload if possible.
sam_sales: From their ops: `HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request {"error": "embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 640"}`. They also hit 413 when sending ~4k candidates.
anya_ml: 1536 vs 640 means their embed model is compact. Could be a bespoke internal model or a downsampling step. Also base64-encoded vectors can cause bloat/413s.
chris_se: Quick repro checklist for them: 1) run `print(len(get_embedding('x')))`, 2) check `type(candidates[0][0])` (float vs string), 3) try chunking candidates to <=250.
sam_sales: They confirmed len=640 and said their client sometimes emits base64 for binary paths.
leo_eng: Options to unblock: A) Have them switch to our 1536 embed model (fastest). B) Use server-side embedding for POC: send raw docs & set `embed_on_server=true`. C) Train a 640->1536 projection (not ideal).
anya_ml: Perf/narrowing tips: prefilter with ANN client-side (embed -> top-K 300) then send for rerank; or use rerank-medium for demos. Server-side embed adds latency ~80-160ms per 200 candidates depending on model.
sam_sales: Ops asked for a simple curl for server-side embed so they can validate immediately.
leo_eng: cURL (sanitized): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"raw_documents":["doc1","doc2"],"query":"how to migrate","rerank_model":"rerank-large","embed_on_server":true,"max_candidates":250}'
```
chris_se: Also tell them to enable `Content-Encoding: gzip` and chunk if they still hit 413. Example python chunker: `for c in chunks(candidates,250): post_rerank(c)`
maya_sec: Security note: server-side embed ingests customer text. Before ingesting PII we need an NDA + completed infosec questionnaire. Dedicated/private deploy reduces data residency concerns but requires SSO/KMS setup. I'll DM our SOC2 summary and questionnaire.
sam_sales: Customer asked about cost for server-side embed during POC and Dedicated benefits. Quick guide: sales can offer POC embedding credits (typical ~40-50% off up to a cap for 30 days). Dedicated removes noisy rate limits and gives capacity commits; pricing is custom.
leo_eng: Immediate ask from us: please attach a single failing payload (sanitized) and run the `len()` + `type()` checks. If they want us to enable server-side embed for them, confirm org id and we can flip a short-lived flag.
ops_bot: Deployment note - feature flag request queued for org-halotech at 2028-04-02T12:05:00Z
sam_sales: Thanks all — I'll collect the single payload and the len/type checks from HaloTech and report back. Will also open a POC credit request and start the NDA exchange. :thumbsup:
